mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build new exterior stairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for building new exterior stairs varies significantly based on complexity, material choice, and site conditions. Simple wooden stairs might take a few days, while complex designs with concrete or custom masonry can extend to several weeks. Factors like weather, accessibility of the site, and the need for excavation or specialized equipment also influence the timeline.
